title: thermohydraulic performance of spray cooling systems: a general model by machine learning
core_idea: Develop a general predictive framework for spray cooling thermohydraulic performance by applying six machine learning algorithms to data aggregated from 25 prior studies (covering different working fluids, atomization types, Reynolds/Nusselt/Weber numbers), propose a general correlation for thermal performance, integrate that correlation into the ML models, and use SHAP explanations to interpret the models and guide optimization of key spray-cooling factors.
tldr: Create an interpretable, general ML-based model—augmented by a derived general correlation—to predict and optimize spray cooling thermal and hydraulic performance across diverse fluids, atomization methods, and operating conditions.
